Senses.Explanation: Raising the eyebrows and blinking is an observable facial response whose value changes with the encounter; the action itself does not certify what it means. Mazu Daoyi explicitly makes the gesture right at some times and wrong at others. A questioner says it is not yet an adept’s working, while Zhongji Kezun and Dongshan Shouchu compare formulaic gesture to confinement or a kitchen rag. A visiting monk reports it as evidence of pervasive awareness; Tianran Hanshi analyzes Mazu’s alternating use, and Chushi Fanqi condemns instant certification based on the gesture alone.

Senses.PreferredTarget: raise a sound to stop its echo
SearchAliases: raise a sound to stop its echo
Senses.Note: Five Chinese Zen uses criticize attempts to repair a problem by repeating its cause: Dahui’s letter, Zhongfeng’s case verse, and separate Binya, Lianyue and Yun’e commentaries. The Yongming doctrinal example is excluded.

Occurrences.Kwic: 是處。五濁世中種種虛幻。無一真實。請行住坐臥常作是觀。則日久月深。漸漸消磨矣。然正煩惱時。子細揣摩窮詰。從甚麼處起。若窮起處不得。現今煩惱底。却從甚麼處得來。正煩惱時。是有是無。是虛是實。窮來窮去。心無所之。要思量但思量。要哭但哭。哭來哭去。思量來思量去。抖擻得藏識中許多恩愛習氣盡時。自然如水歸水。還我箇本來無煩惱無思量無憂無喜底去耳。入得世間。出世無餘。世間法則佛法。佛法則世間法也。父子天性一而已。若子喪而父不煩惱不思量。如父喪而子不煩惱不思量。還得也無。若硬止遏哭時又不敢哭。思量時又不敢思量。是特欲逆天理滅天性揚聲止響潑油救火耳。正當煩惱時。總不是外事。且不得作外邊想。永嘉云。無明實性即佛性。幻化空身即法身。是真語實語不誑不妄等語。恁麼見得了。要思量要煩惱。亦不可得。作是觀者名為正觀。若他觀者名為邪觀。邪正未分。正好著力。此是妙喜決定義無智人前莫說。答夏運使答夏運使示諭。道契則霄壤共處。趣異則覿面楚越。誠哉是言。即此乃不傳之妙。左右發意。欲作妙喜書。未操觚拂紙。已兩手分付了也。又何待堅忍究竟。以俟他日耶。此箇道理。唯證者方默默相契。難與俗子言。延平乃閩嶺佳處。左右能自調伏不為逆順關棙子所轉。便是大解脫人。此人能轉一切關棙子。日用
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1998A.xml). In a letter to Wang Yanzhang, Dahui Zonggao says refusing to weep or think while troubled is like raising a sound to stop an echo or pouring oil on fire. The phrase rejects suppression that worsens the grief it tries to cure.

Occurrences.Kwic: 皮綴骨。雲門乾屎橛滯殼迷封。衲僧面前放過不可。祖師門下再犯難容。常教肚裏如鍼刺。拋向洪波白浪中。祖師道。欲知兩𫨻元是一空。義解者商量道。兩𫨻即指前之心法。所言一空非太虛頑然之空。非小乘斷滅之空。乃靈覺無相之真空耳。此空是諸佛之源萬靈之母。無聲無臭。昭昭於羣象之前。不有不無。朗朗於諸塵之表者是也。闢曰。是空不應有知。既知不應名空。苟未曾與祖師握手親到真空之海。言語云乎哉。偈曰。夢中钁得黃金藏又跨青鸞上寶臺盡夜喜歡無著處天明只落得場獃一空同兩齊含萬象一句無私。萬靈同仰。遠拍祖肩。清機歷掌。大顛打首座聚雪埋金。興化罰維那揚聲止響。惟有石敢當。長年整歲。向百眾人前出一頭。今古無人解稱賞。祖師道。一空同兩齊含萬象。義解者卜度道。心不異法。是一空同兩。法不異心。是齊含萬象。所以古云。見色便見心。無色心不現。又教中謂。森羅及萬象一法之所印。故祖師發明於此。闢曰。講經則許你講。要見祖師意。何異鄭州出曹門。偈曰。一不成單兩不雙夜深寒月印長江無邊宇宙光吞盡又引梅花上矮䆫不見精麤寧有偏黨禪名關教名網。撈摝三有眾生。及第心空標榜。撞著箇沒意智漢。掣其檈解其紐。萬目要張不張。百夫欲掌不掌。無心道者合如斯。豈是人前呈伎倆。所以道。不見精麤寧有偏黨。義解者謂心法

Occurrences.Kwic: 復舉：「三聖道：『我逢人則不出，出則便為人。』興化道：『我逢人則出，出則不為人。』」拈云：「二尊宿恁麼說話，大似揚聲止響。山僧雖是他家兒孫，出處卻不同，說甚為人、不為人？只是相逢便棒。何故？塵中雖有隱身術，爭似全身入帝鄉？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J29/J29nB235.xml). Lianyue Daozheng raises the words of two older teachers about speaking for people, says their talk merely raises sound to stop an echo, and then offers his own different way. The image marks the insufficiency of their verbal remedy.

Occurrences.Kwic: 復舉：「趙州示眾云：『我向南方行腳，火爐頭有箇無賓主句，直至如今無人舉著。』」師乃召大眾，云：「還會麼？若會得，趙州老漢無地容身；其或未然，不免重下註腳。『我向行腳南方，火爐頭有箇無賓主句』，也是貧兒思舊債；『直至如今無人舉著』，切忌揚聲止響。普濟恁麼批判，還有為趙州作主底麼？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB203.xml). Yun’e Xi takes up an explanation of Zhaozhou’s saying and warns his assembly against raising a sound to stop an echo. He uses the pair to test whether a comment on the old case only adds more noise.

Senses.Explanation: “Raise a sound to stop its echo” names an attempt to end an effect by reinforcing its cause. Dahui Zonggao warns a correspondent that suppressing grief or thought while distressed is like pouring oil on a fire. Zhongfeng Mingben applies the image to Xinghua’s handling of a case. Binya Jian calls even his own presentation of the old teaching an echo-making move; Lianyue Daozheng judges two earlier masters’ sayings that way and offers a different response; Yun’e Xi challenges a Zhaozhou explanation in the same terms. Yongming’s systematic doctrinal exposition repeats the sound-and-echo analogy but is not admitted as another Zen-record witness.

Senses.PreferredTarget: By your own conditions, you belong with Deshan
SearchAliases: by your own conditions, you belong with deshan
Senses.Note: When Xuefeng overturns the rice basin, Dongshan says that his conditions belong with Deshan. Liangting revisits the episode while discussing lineages and the danger of claiming a master by style alone. Guantao asks whether Dongshan’s apparent refusal of Xuefeng shows a deeper judgment. Zhe’an replies with a verse, and Gumei asks why later readers make the exchange a boundary between houses. The saying points to a student’s encounter and capacity, not a permanent rank.

Occurrences.Kwic: 下雲門、法眼兩宗，祗明得個回互法門，到底石頭路滑，幾般瞎漢硬將他龍潭崇信割去青原，扯入南嶽。須知江西、湖南摠只一宗，在彼在此何勞分別？雪峰老漢嘗云：『自從先德山、石頭以來，傳此秘密本自分明，又特舉門門一切境，回互不回互為言，是何意旨？』當時洞山、德山每每節拍相應，巖頭見德山，跨門便喝，山便打，頭禮拜，洞山云：『不是奯公，大難承當。』巖頭云：『我當時一手抬、一手搦。』雪峰三登投子、九上洞山，淘沙淘米、枯木糝花，約莫有幾分成就了？洞山云：『據子因緣，合在德山。』指他到德山去。欽山、文邃、巖頭、雪峰生死同條，或嗣洞山、或嗣德山，並祖湖南，旨歸是一，從上來血脈井然，明眼人前舉起自薦。今人趁口說德山棒、臨濟喝，瞎驢趕大隊，遠之遠矣。三家村裏土地公公，莫認驢鞍橋作阿爺下頷。」為栖霞竺菴和尚設供，上堂。「鷓鴣聲裏送離憂，零亂桃花泣未休，可是五天歸去疾，新豐寥落使人愁。我竺庵法兄和尚，湖濱一別，于今五年，勝萬斛于西江，飛九重之聖箭。左青原、右南嶽，從大好山下開二甘露門；前采石、後栖霞，在浪杖人前標正法

Senses.Explanation: A judicial formula for reaching a verdict from the stated particulars. In Chan commentary it means judging an old case from what has actually been said or done. Mingjue, Dahui in two distinct discourses, and Yuanwu each use the formula in present case judgment. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.

Senses.Explanation: The courtroom phrase judges old cases or present Chan exchanges as matters settled on the evidence. At a requested hall talk, Baiyu Jingsi recounts the Buddha telling Ananda to take his alms bowl, then faults both figures. He says he will settle their case on the facts, waves his whisk, and gives a verse; the selected phrase is his pointed verdict on that old exchange. At a hall talk requested for the deceased Lady Jing, Miaoyun Zhenxiong describes her release from birth and death, strikes the floor with his staff, and says Great Compassion has already settled the case. He then asks what he should say for the patron's memorial, so the legal metaphor marks the completed matter before his dedication. Baichi Xingyuan recalls his teacher Feiyin Tongrong answering a monk at a prayer for a child. After the monk's auspicious image, Feiyin says the case can be settled on the facts.
